title: 第1623章 装甲神使
slug: 顶级奸商无敌从贩卖军火开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

听到这声音，林风第一时间皱眉。

阿四更是浑身一颤，满脸惊恐的看向后方。

只见他们来的通道后，涌入一群人。

看他们头顶的名字，全都来自一个叫哈里神教的公会。

为首的是哈里神教的会长，名叫天生富贵。

也不知道是不是翻译问题，确实是这样写的。

阿四看到天生富贵脸色一阵白。

【我…我。。】

【你什么你？你不知道贝乌特是我的人吗？】

他所说的贝乌特，正是之前在深渊口对他们出手的公会。

哈里神教麾下的人。

阿四颤声说道：【不。。不知道，真不知道。】

【不知道？你耍我？想死？？】天生富贵瞪大双眼：【那我就让你全家去死。】

【不不，我不想死，求尊贵的您原谅我的行为。】

他卑微到泥土里，跪在地上祈求般说道。

这行为让林风两人匪夷所思。

什么就求他了。

在深渊入口的时候，明明是对面先攻击他们。

阿四没有任何解释，就在不断求饶。

好像阿四的生命就掌握在天生富贵中。

或许这就是渡硬国的奇葩之处吧。

剑不凡实在看不下去，沉声说道：【阿四，起来，这里是游戏。】

【不是，你们也和我一起跪下吧。】

【卧槽~~你是跪太久了吧？？】

两个文化激烈碰撞。

渡硬国讲究的是种族制，高种人面对低种人有生杀大权，甚至会觉得被高种人奴役是一件天经地义的事情。

而大夏国，讲究王侯将相宁有种乎。

虽然有钱人能做的事情很多。

可如果在大夏，你把人逼急了，他会让你知道，这世上最公平的事情是每个人只有一条命。

什么种族制，什么高低贵贱，不好使。

【他算什么东西？跪他？你是不是疯了？给老子起来。】

阿四不敢动，还在那跪着颤抖。

天生富贵眼神阴冷的看向剑不凡：【大夏人，我劝你不要掺和到我们渡硬国的事情里来，水很深的，小心淹死你。】

阿四没有和林风两人组队。

也无法私聊他们，只能不断使眼神，用可能只有他自己听到的话细语：【别和他吵~】

【呵呵，你爷爷我什么大风大浪没见过，你们渡硬国叫水深？那TM不就是小阴沟吗？恶心死人。】

Page (1/3)

Hearing this voice, Lin Feng frowned immediately.

Ah Si trembled all over and looked back with a horrified face.

I saw a group of people pouring in behind the passage they came from.

Looking at the names above their heads, they all come from a guild called the Harry Cult.

The leader is the president of the Harry Cult, named Born Rich.

I don’t know if it’s a translation problem, but it is indeed written like this.

Ah Si's face turned pale when he saw that he was born rich.

【I...I..】

【What are you?Don’t you know Beut is mine?】

The Beut he was talking about was the guild that attacked them at the mouth of the abyss.

People under the command of the Harry Cult.

Ah Si said tremblingly: [No..I don’t know, I really don’t know.】

【have no idea?Are you kidding me?Want to die??】 Born to be rich, his eyes widened: 【Then I will let your whole family die.】

[No, no, I don’t want to die, please forgive me for my behavior.】

He humbled himself to the earth, knelt on the ground and prayed.

This behavior made Lin Feng and the two people unbelievable.

Just ask him for anything.

When they were at the entrance of the abyss, the other side obviously attacked them first.

Ah Si kept begging for mercy without any explanation.

It seemed that Ah Si's life depended on his natural wealth.

Perhaps this is the strange thing about crossing the hard country.

Jian Bufan couldn't stand it anymore and said in a deep voice: [Ah Si, get up, this is a game.】

[No, you should also kneel down with me.】

[Fuck~~Have you been kneeling for too long??】

The two cultures collided fiercely.

The hard country emphasizes the racial system. People of higher races have the power of life and death when facing people of lower races. They may even feel that being enslaved by people of higher races is a matter of course.

In Daxia, the kings, princes, generals, and generals are all very concerned about being in harmony with each other.

Although there are many things that rich people can do.

But if you push someone into a hurry in Daxia, he will let you know that the fairest thing in the world is that everyone only has one life.

What kind of racial system, what kind of hierarchy, it’s not easy to work.

【Who is he?Kneel him?Are you crazy?Get up for me.】

Ah Si didn't dare to move and was still kneeling there shaking.

The man who was born rich looked at Jian Bufan with cold eyes: [Daxia people, I advise you not to get involved in our crossing the Hard Country. The water is very deep. Be careful of drowning you.】

Ah Si did not team up with Lin Feng.

He couldn't chat with them privately. He could only keep making eye contact and whisper in words that only he could hear: "Don't argue with him~"

[Haha, your grandfather and I have never seen such strong winds and waves. How can you call it deep water when you cross a hard country?Isn't that a small sewer?Disgusting.】
